2015 Notes from the Marking Centre — Mathematics
Introduction
This document has been produced for the teachers and candidates of the Stage 6 Mathematics
course. It
contains comments on candidate responses to the 2015 Higher School Certificate examination,
highlighting
their strengths in particular parts of the examination and indicating where candidates need
to improve.
This document should be read along with:
the Mathematics Stage 6 Syllabus
the 2015 Higher School Certificate Mathematics examination
the marking guidelines
Advice for HSC students about examinations
other support documents developed by the Board of Studies, Teaching and Educational
Standards
NSW to assist in the teaching and learning of Mathematics in Stage 6.
